mapper.select: select id,run_status,current_stage,system_pipeline_code,system_pipeline_version from batch.pipeline_instance where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and id=#{pipelineInstanceId}

select s.id as step_id, s.pipeline_instance_id, s.step_code, s.stage_code, s.step_status, , null::bigint as total_rows_hint, pr.updated_at as last_heartbeat_at, s.run_seq, s.error_code from batch.pipeline_step_run s join batch.pipeline_instance p on p.id = s.pipeline_instance_id
left join batch.pipeline_progress pr on pr.tenant_id = p.tenant_id and pr.pipeline_instance_id = s.pipeline_instance_id and pr.stage = s.stage_code where p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and s.pipeline_instance_id = #{pipelineInstanceId} order by s.run_seq asc, s.id asc

select distinct on (s.stage_code) s.id as step_id, s.pipeline_instance_id, s.step_code, s.stage_code, s.step_status, , null::bigint as total_rows_hint, pr.updated_at as last_heartbeat_at, s.run_seq, s.error_code from batch.pipeline_step_run s join batch.pipeline_instance p on p.id = s.pipeline_instance_id
left join batch.pipeline_progress pr on pr.tenant_id = p.tenant_id and pr.pipeline_instance_id = s.pipeline_instance_id and pr.stage = s.stage_code where p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and s.pipeline_instance_id = #{pipelineInstanceId} order by s.stage_code, s.run_seq desc, s.id desc

select p.file_id as file_id, fr.file_name as file_name from batch.pipeline_instance p left join batch.file_record fr on fr.id = p.file_id where p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and p.id = #{pipelineInstanceId}
